snippet.title: Jedi Knight - Dark Forces 2 - Unreal Engine - Release 1.02 - Free Download
snippet.description:
DARK FORCES 2 UNREAL ENGINE REMAKE V1.02        

Description:
Welcome to my first Unreal Engine project.
The goal was to recreate one of my favorite games back from my childhood while keeping the base look, feeling and gameplay
and of course learning the engine itself.

After nearly 3 years of development the project is finally at a point where I feel ready to share it with you.

Original game by Lucasarts from 1997

Version 1.02 comes with:
- 2 offical levels from the original game
- 4 Survival levels
- a Sandbox mode 
- 3d model viewer
- bonus level for testing
- some secrets...

major changes:

-New official level "The Lost Disc" added
-Everything unlocked from the start

-Improved sandbox mode by adding settings to replace enemy types or items on the main levels
-Difficulty settings affect enemy count / strength / fire rate / weapon damage and also the speed of moving objects such as elevators or conveyor belts

-Difficulty can be changed later without removing / adding profile

-E11 Blaster spread increases when on full auto
-E11 Blaster headshots do double damage

-New NPCs: Gamoray Guard and Protocol Droid added
-Improved project file size
-lots of bug fixes and changes

Author: Ruppertle
Download Version 1.02 for free here:
(Link on the patreon page)

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/BkPjRMpkeq

Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/posts/dark-forces-2-v1-92833911?utm_medium=clipboard_copy&utm_source=copyLink&utm_campaign=postshare_creator&utm_content=join_link

Testers: Rotzie Der Popel, AnnySkywalker, Zeus, Kob the Killa, Kevin O’Brien, ackehallgren, Lewiechewie, readypixelone, Macser
